actions.action: Cut the damaged stem right at or below the bend
Check whether new leaves or a solid piece emerge from the center
If a solid piece pushes out of the center, remove the whole leaf spike
Grind fallen plant material with a leaf shredder and return it around the trees

verdict.reason: The answer is scraped banana-plant comments that never identify transplant shock, though cutting off bent growth overlaps partly with trimming dead stuff (without the watering advice), and nothing is likely to harm the plant.
